g.text: For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America
Tropical cyclone formation is not expected during the next 7 days.
For the eastern and central North Pacific east of 180 longitude
Area 1: Well Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands
A broad area of low pressure is forecast to develop well to the
southeast of the Hawaiian Islands by early next week. Thereafter,
environmental conditions appear generally favorable for gradual
development of this system, and a tropical depression could form
by the end of next week as it moves westward to west-northwestward
